name: What are the best rooms for a bump-out addition?

mainEntity.name: What are the best rooms for a bump-out addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common rooms for bump-out additions are kitchens and bathrooms. In kitchens, extending an exterior wall by three to four feet creates adequate clearance to add a center island, expand counter workspace, or install a row of floor-to-ceiling pantry cabinets. In bathrooms, a bump-out provides the extra depth required to install a freestanding soaking tub, expand a standard shower into a walk-in custom tile shower, or accommodate a double-sink vanity. Other common uses include bedroom walk-in closets, mudroom entries, and sunny dining banquettes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchens and bathrooms are the most common rooms for bump-outs, providing extra space for islands, pantries, double vanities, or walk-in showers.
